items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Jack Lane told me about it. / I'm pretty sure he's the one Jack Lane

ctx.x: Oh the first job I played with a fellow by the name of Stevens, Ernest Stevens, who was from way downtown on St. Claude Street. He was a barber. And on the side he made up little concert groups. And we used to go in the parks and play concerts. That's when I was, oh gee this was so long ago. And then we played some jazz band jobs, you know, no piano, upright bass, horn and drums and trombone and trumpet and clarinet. I played a couple of the dance jobs and then I played in the old Millenburg, a couple of those…
As a drummer I think he's still alive. Jack Lane told me about it.
